Name: Simple Skills Extented 2
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F2C879]📖 Simple Skills Extented 2[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/heading]

PC 2.27 • Android experimental 1.12

A more balanced version of SSE 1, with reduced yield and combat bonuses. Extend Farming, Fishing, Foraging, Mining and Combat to level 110. Choose from 76 professions and 131 ranks, with up to 23 profession points per skill. Each skill progresses past 10 independently, without waiting for the other skills. Previously banked XP activates automatically when loading your character.

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]✨ Professions & Points[/color][/heading]

Earn 16 points per skill from levels 35–110, one every five levels. Four completed trials add four points, and three profession manuals add three more: 23 points per skill. Each rank costs one point and requires the previous rank. Most professions unlock at level 35; advanced professions unlock at 105. You can learn every profession at rank I, but cannot maximize every rank.

Abilities include Transplant, Scythe Harvest, Crop Insight, Dash, Timed Guard, Orchard Sweep and Coal Prospector. Gentle Hands grants +5 / +10 friendship on each animal’s first successful manual pet of the day. Learned effects can be switched off without losing their ranks or refunding their points.

Forage Helper replaces the Temporary Collector profession reward. At Foraging level 35, spend one profession point to unlock Marnie's permanent Forage Collector (25,000g) and Deluxe upgrade (75,000g). The Deluxe upgrade provides 70 storage slots and preserves the collector's stored items. With Simple Forage Helper or an active Simple Essentials helper installed, this profession is unavailable and that mod keeps its own unlock rules. Simple Forage Helper 1.1 uses its Farming level 10 shop requirement. Existing profession ranks, temporary collectors and stored contents are retained.

PC 2.27's shop unlock, purchases and Deluxe storage persistence were checked through a full save/restart in a copied-save modpack test.

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🏅 Trials & Profession Manuals[/color][/heading]

Each skill has four activity trials, unlocked at levels 25, 50, 70 and 100. Complete and claim them in order for a medal and one profession point each. Objectives cover crops and animal products, fishing, forage and trees, mining and metalworking, or combat.

Find three personal manuals per skill through qualifying skill activities. Manuals have no level requirement; each edition grants one point when read. Read an edition before searching for the next. A guaranteed fallback prevents endless bad luck. The Trials & Manuals menu shows eligible activities, drop odds and the action counter. Points earned early are banked until profession spending opens at level 35.

[heading][color=#F2C879]🌱 Automatic Level Rewards[/color][/heading]

Farming: crop and animal produce, seed refunds, quality, growth and fertilizer benefits.
Fishing: bite speed, tackle protection, fishing-bar size, perfect-catch bonuses and treasure rewards.
Foraging: wood, tree seeds, eligible ground forage and berry pickup reach.
Mining: ore, coal, stone, gems, geodes and mining benefits.
Combat: health, direct melee bonuses, monster loot and recovery.

At level 110, automatic bonuses reach:
[b]Extra crop yield: +30%[/b]
[b]Extra animal produce: +30%[/b]
[b]Seed refund chance: 20%[/b]
[b]Fertilizer refund chance: 20%[/b]
[b]Matching ground forage: +30% per original item[/b]
[b]Different local seasonal forage: 20% chance[/b]

All six curves are rescaled and first reach their maximum at level 110. Profession bonuses are separate. Genuinely perfect eligible rod catches retain up to a 70% chance for one additional fish.

Berry Reach adds up to 32 pixels of berry pickup distance. Sure Footing reduces monster knockback by up to 10%, combining multiplicatively with Steady Footing. Light Cast reduces native casting energy costs by up to 10%.

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]📚 Skills Journal & Profession Choices[/color][/heading]

Owned original choices are recognized, while genuine missing choices and respecs remain available. Existing XP, levels and earned professions are retained.

Inspect current bonuses, future levels, professions, trials, manuals and achievements in the Skills Journal. Spend available points through Perks whenever you are ready; another five-level increase is not required.

Use Skip remaining notices / Skip all notices on an SSE reward window to dismiss that night’s remaining notices. Keyboard X and controller Y also work. Unspent points and outstanding profession choices stay available in the journal. To hide optional notices permanently, turn off Show level-up reward windows in settings.

For outstanding vanilla profession choices earned at levels 15, 20, 25 and 30, open Skills Journal → Perks, select the skill, then choose Claim earned professions. Use the button, P, or controller View/Back. No new level-up or sleep is required. Cancel with Escape, right-click or controller B. A claimed choice cannot be awarded again.

The achievement cabinet includes 80 level milestones, cosmetic titles at 50, 75 and 100, and a level-100 display trophy for each skill. Level 105 and 110 milestones display Iridium IV and V badges for all five skills.

Adjust SSE menu text from 100% to 200% in [b]Skills Journal → Settings → Text size[/b] or Generic Mod Config Menu. Available for all 12 supported languages, with wrapping and scrolling for larger text. The default is 100%.

English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Simplified Chinese follow the game’s selected language.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]📦 Installation & Upgrading from SSE 1[/color][/heading]

Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ on PC and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/url]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional. Extract SimpleSkillsExtented2 into Mods and launch through SMAPI. Install only one SSE edition.

Back up your save and config.json before replacing SSE 1. Keep the same save and copy the old config.json into the SSE 2 folder to retain settings. Supported stored XP, levels and earned professions are preserved. New SSE 2 level points are calculated from the preserved level: level 100 gives 14, and level 110 gives 16, before trial/manual rewards. Claim outstanding vanilla choices through the journal. Do not run SSE 1’s removal preparation when upgrading to SSE 2.

[heading][color=#9ACAF7]🤝 Other Mods[/color][/heading]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48079]Wildroot Chronicles[/url] 1.4.5: new seed refunds preserve the planted seed’s variety, traits and other item metadata. Ground planting, pots and Row Planter are covered. The maximum seed-refund chance is 20% at level 110. Android includes the shared integration.

The five native base skills stay capped at 10. SSE tracks its extended levels and rewards separately up to 110. Temporary food and drink skill buffs still apply.

SSE takes priority with Level Extender 3.0.0 for the five shared skills and overlapping duplication, crop-growth, fishing and tool-stamina effects. Level Extender’s automatic vanilla-skill progression pauses while its stored records, custom skills and unrelated features remain. Use the SSE journal for SSE progression.

SSE supports Farming Level Affects Harvest priority. SSE filters its crop-level yield increase while preserving normal crop yields, native multi-harvest behavior and unrelated crop changes. The filter targets that content-pack family; other yield mods are not globally disabled.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39744]Enhanced Rings[/url] 1.8.12: Extra Fish Ring bonuses are preserved. SSE applies its own perfect-catch and frenzy rewards separately, adding at most two extra fish.

SSE keeps its XP, earned levels and rewards independent when using supported skill-overhaul adapters. Integrations cover Mastery Extended, Walk of Life, Vanilla Plus Professions and Apex Mastery. SpaceCore and Simple Skill Bars can display SSE progression. Simple Experience Bar 1.7 displays SSE 2 levels and XP. Custom skills keep their own progression.

Compatibility depends on the other mod’s version. Walk of Life and Vanilla Plus Professions remain incompatible with each other; SSE does not resolve that pairing.

[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🧪 Android Experimental — Optional File[/color][/heading]

Android Experimental 1.12 includes the PC 2.27 shared features and priority adapters for Level Extender and Farming Level Affects Harvest. It retains trials, activity manuals, up to 23 profession points per skill, migration and direct profession claiming. The six rescaled caps above also apply to Android; seed refunds reach 20% at level 110. Trials & Manuals supports swipe scrolling and tap-to-claim. Target: Android game 1.6.15.3 with a compatible SMAPI port exposing API 4.3.2+.

Extract SimpleSkillsExtented2Android into Mods and install only one SSE edition. Back up your save and retain config.json when upgrading. Checks-only mode is on by default. To enable gameplay, set AndroidCompatibilityChecksOnly=false in config.json and restart; required compatibility checks must pass. Read android-compatibility.json if startup is blocked. Existing Android opt-in settings are retained. Open the journal with its HUD book button. Active abilities require an assigned key or controller button; dedicated ability touch buttons are not included. Farmhand transplant requests are disabled on Android.

[heading][color=#F2C879]🐛 Bug Reports & Suggestions[/color][/heading]

Include your edition/version, game and SMAPI versions, platform, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. Include android-compatibility.json for Android reports. Generative AI assisted code, translations and page content.
